independent_parent_decisions.parent_context: The individual Exline2008Study7report explicitly states OVERALL that the original male-vengefulness finding failed to replicate. Its subsequent theoretical-forgiveness interpretation is a different newly observed TRIM main effect that the original authors did not observe, not a returning original empirical result. The year2007/2008typo does not change the exact named Study7identity. Apply whole-author verdict rather than borrowing a novel theoretical agreement to make mixed.

The Lemay/Clark WalkingOnEggshells Experiment5report explicitly confirms the original rating main effect and explicitly contrasts a missing rating-by-perceived-sensitivity interaction. Its failure sentence names that particular perceived-sensitivity effect, then immediately retains the main effect; it is not an unqualified verdict dismissing the whole set of original comparisons. Rule2and the codebook mixed example apply to the authors own matched contrasts. Possible manipulation explanations are not an author declaration that the completed attempt was uninformative.

The Rule/Ambady CEO-profit individual report expressly synthesizes the findings OVERALL as consistent with the original study, despite failing the arbitrary selected leadership-correlation significance criterion. Its Summary warns against overinterpreting that binary criterion, while power-profit and factor structure agree. The codebook trusts the authors overall original-specific judgment over a single p-value/criterion, so successful is supported. Underpowered caution is not an author verdict that this attempt cannot adjudicate. The individual title/design/reference identify TheFaceOfSuccess despite discordant master-rowjournal metadata; another Rule/Ambady paper is not silently substituted.

The complete Kirchler/Huber/Stoeckl TharSheBursts individual report explicitly confirms the original RAD mispricing contrast but explicitly fails its separately compared original RD overpricing contrast. Discussion calls the HYPOTHESISOFINTEREST replicated, referring to RADandp=.010; this particular-effect statement cannot override the named opposing original RD comparison under codebookRule1/2. The earlier native final reply confused TharSheBursts with a different TharSheBlows paper and remains invalid, not repaired or promoted. Narrative effect-size inconsistency is retained without arithmetic repair. Both positive and negative evidence passages are individually literal in the source-context receipt; no splicing is used.

The Fox/Rottenstreich current authors explicitly preregister a WHOLE-TARGET interpretation criterion and conclude their attempt as a (mostly) successful replication in both Results and Discussion. The codebook gives that author overall verdict precedence over individual successful/unsuccessful studies; the parent is not imposing a 3of4success threshold. The following phrase mostly-successful-yet-mixed describes the component results, with the failures openly retained, but does not revoke the stated overall criterion/outcome. Weaker effect sizes alone also do not make mixed. This hierarchy is documented rather than hiding the qualified wording or selecting only one comparison.
